named_events.loss_description: Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 84.9m on a net basis, adding 9.8% to the net loss ratio, primarily as a result of business interruption (UK Property and Treaty Property classes), the recessionary impacts of the pandemic following the sharp decline in economic activity (Casualty, Political Risk and Treaty classes) as well as from an increase in medical expenses and travel related claims (Accident and Health).
The largest loss experienced was hurricane Laura (GBP 27.2m).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net prior year strengthening of GBP 20.059 million in 2020, representing 1.19% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse run-off deviation was observed across both direct insurance and inwards reinsurance business lines, with a mix of releases and strengthenings at the line of business level. The report notes "adverse development on business written outside of the current underwriting year" and "single large losses" as contributing factors to adverse prior year development. The year was significantly impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, resulting in GBP 84.9 million net claims, and a record-breaking hurricane season including Hurricane Laura (GBP 27.2 million), Hurricanes Zeta and Sally, and other US weather events. The largest gross premiums written were in Fire & other damage to property, Third party liability, and Reinsurance inwards.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was available from a movement note or claims development triangle. The interpretation of parentheses in Note 9 (Net claims outstanding) as indicating adverse development (strengthening) is based on the narrative 'net deteriorations occurred' on page 15, which contradicts standard accounting notation where parentheses typically denote negative values. LOB mapping for 'Pecuniary Loss' is 'Other'. LOB mapping for 'Marine & Energy' is 'Marine'. LOB mapping for 'Marine, aviation and transport' is 'Aviation'. LOB mapping for 'Third party liability' is 'Casualty'. LOB mapping for 'Fire & other damage to property' is 'Property'. LOB mapping for 'Reinsurance inwards' is 'Reinsurance - Specialty' as no further breakdown is provided.
